what_this_is: The ungated Supa 1.7 SOURCE checkpoint measured on RRP2-DEV-V1, a held-out Forge v1 validation bank it has never been trained on. This is a baseline for future arms, not a quality claim about any candidate.

denominators.length_bias_warning: Overlength rows were REJECTED, never truncated, so the evaluated subset is systematically shorter than the bank. Report both denominators.

sibling_collision.why_sentinels_are_excluded: A constant-UNKNOWN predictor otherwise scores a 0.707 collision rate on this bank purely because UNKNOWN is also a sibling gold in most families. That is abstention, not interference.
sibling_collision.baseline_required: Compare against this same statistic computed on the answer-agnostic shortcut predictors. A model rate at or below the shortcut rate refutes the B-1 interference reading.
sibling_collision.no_analytic_chance_level: Intentionally omitted: it would depend on the predictor's output distribution and any formula would be arbitrary.

clears_the_shortcut_floor.meaning: The source is doing something beyond any trivial answer-agnostic strategy. This is a BASELINE for future arms, not a quality claim.

abstention_is_miscalibrated_in_both_dire.meaning: A constant-UNKNOWN predictor BEATS the model outright on the UNKNOWN stratum while scoring 0 on ANSWER. Held-out confirmation of bottleneck B-2, with explicit denominators. Any arm that raises overall accuracy while worsening either direction has not improved abstention.

the_collision_statistic_cannot_test_B1_w.why_the_comparison_is_INVALID: The source model has never been trained on this bank, so its 0.2147 rate cannot be memorization interference. Inspection of the collisions shows the real cause: closed answer vocabularies. deduction has only four legal labels, so predicting SUPPORTED where the gold is UNKNOWN is an inevitable coincidence; and in program_trace the SAME wrong integer -2 collides with golds 2, 6 and 0. The shortcut baselines collide rarely only because they copy long prompt identifiers, which are almost never golds. They are not fluency-matched and are therefore the wrong null.
the_collision_statistic_cannot_test_B1_w.the_valid_null_now_exists: The source model's own 0.2147 on this exact bank IS a fluency-matched null. B-1 as reinterpreted (cross-world memorization interference) is tested by asking whether a FITTED candidate's collision rate rises substantially above 0.2147 on the same bank. B-1 remains UNTESTED until that comparison is run.

B3_is_real_but_this_scorer_cannot_separa.observed: The contract wants 'venue=X; format=Y; day=Z'. The model emits prose such as 'Please use BoatHouse for my venue.' -- and the content is also wrong (gold venue Atrium). Another case, 'audio for my format; Wednesday for my day', gets one slot right, one wrong, and omits the third.
B3_is_real_but_this_scorer_cannot_separa.why_presentation_only_is_zero: tolerant() only normalizes whitespace, strips outer quotes and drops one trailing sentence mark. It cannot parse a slot contract, so it rescues nothing here and the presentation/reasoning split is not measurable. B-3's falsifying test needs a slot-aware parser scoring per-slot, which is NOT built.

the_evaluated_subset_is_length_biased.stratum_composition_roughly_preserved: ANSWER:UNKNOWN is 206:34 evaluated against 328:56 in the full bank, so the stratum ratio survives (6.06 vs 5.86). Per-family rejection varies from 11 (source_boundaries) to 22 (document_reconciliation), so family weights DID shift and per-family numbers are not comparable to the full bank.
the_evaluated_subset_is_length_biased.meaning: This is a SHORT-CONTEXT measurement at the qualified 2048 window. The 144 rejected rows were refused, never truncated. Reporting 0.2625 without both denominators would overstate coverage.
